raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With PD disaggregation, `--disaggregation-decode-enable-offload-kvcache` and EAGLE / EAGLE3 / MTP, no page the decode instance offloads to L3 is ever hit by a later lookup. The next turn recomputes the generated tokens' KV, and the decode-side writes only cost IO and storage.

Under EAGLE the prefill tree keys pages by token bigrams, and so does the storage lookup. The decode offload manager hashed plain tokens, so its keys match no lookup. It also assumed the prefill stored `N // P * P` prompt tokens. A bigram key over N tokens has N - 1 entries, so the prefill stores `(N - 1) // P * P`, and when N is a multiple of the page size one page is written by neither side.

## Modifications

- Read `is_eagle` from the speculative algorithm at init, the same expression `kv_cache_builder.py` passes to the prefill tree. The tree's Mamba exemption does not apply, because decode offload rejects Mamba pools.
- `_compute_prefix_hash` builds a `RadixKey(..., is_bigram=is_eagle)` and hashes it with `get_storage_hash_str`, the helper the tree and the lookup use. Under EAGLE each hashed span carries one lookahead token.
- `_prefill_offloaded_len` subtracts one token under EAGLE before page-aligning.

Non-EAGLE keys are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

New case in `test_specv2_kvcache_offloading.py`: offload an 8-token prompt (page size 4) through `offload_kv_cache` and the write ack, then check that the prefill's stored chain plus the decode-written hashes equals the chain a next-turn lookup computes, with EAGLE on and off.

- main: `is_eagle=True` fails; `is_eagle=False` passes
- this PR: both pass

`test_scheduler_pause_generation.py` gets the new attribute on its stub manager. CPU only; no end-to-end PD run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Not applicable.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related: #45076 (now merged) counts the bigram boundary on the restore side; this PR keys the offload side the same way.

 )
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpeculativeAlgorithm
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
     from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req
@@ -67,6 +70,11 @@ def __init__(
             )
         self.tp_group = tp_group
         self.tp_world_size = torch.distributed.get_world_size(group=self.tp_group)
+        # Same flag as the prefill tree's bigram keys; the tree's Mamba exemption
+        # never applies because decode offload rejects Mamba pools.
+        self.is_eagle = SpeculativeAlgorithm.from_string(
+            get_spec().speculative_algorithm
+        ).is_eagle()
 
         hicache_storage_backend_extra_config = {}
         if get_memory().hicache_storage_backend_extra_config:
@@ -156,7 +164,9 @@ def _has_inflight_offload(self, req: Req):
 
     def _prefill_offloaded_len(self, req: Req) -> int:
         # Page-aligned prompt length; the prefill instance offloaded this part.
-        return len(req.origin_input_ids) // self.page_size * self.page_size
+        # A bigram key over N prompt tokens has N - 1 entries.
+        prompt_key_len = len(req.origin_input_ids) - int(self.is_eagle)
+        return prompt_key_len // self.page_size * self.page_size
 
     def has_inflight_device_transfer(self) -> bool:
         """Whether a device-to-host copy may still read unified KV pages."""
@@ -198,19 +208,21 @@ def offload_kv_cache(self, req) -> bool:
             return False
 
         # Prefill side offloads page-aligned origin_input_ids, decode side offloads the incremental part
-        all_tokens = req.origin_input_ids + req.output_ids[:-1]
+        # output_ids[-1] has no KV yet; it only serves as the bigram lookahead.
+        all_tokens = req.origin_input_ids + req.output_ids
+        lookahead = int(self.is_eagle)
         prefill_offloaded_len = self._prefill_offloaded_len(req)
         state = self.offloaded_state.get(req)
         if state is None:
             prefill_hashes = self._compute_prefix_hash(
-                req, req.origin_input_ids[:prefill_offloaded_len]
+                req, req.origin_input_ids[: prefill_offloaded_len + lookahead]
             )
             last_prefill_hash = (
                 prefill_hashes[-1] if prefill_offloaded_len > 0 else None
             )
             state = OffloadedState(last_hash=last_prefill_hash)
             self.offloaded_state[req] = state
-        incremental_total = len(all_tokens) - prefill_offloaded_len
+        incremental_total = len(all_tokens) - 1 - prefill_offloaded_len
         incremental_new = incremental_total - state.inc_len
         incremental_aligned_len = (
             incremental_new // self.offload_stride * self.offload_stride
@@ -222,7 +234,7 @@ def offload_kv_cache(self, req) -> bool:
         # Extract incremental tokens and indices for the newly available chunk
         start = prefill_offloaded_len + state.inc_len
         end = start + incremental_aligned_len
-        incremental_tokens = all_tokens[start:end]
+        incremental_tokens = all_tokens[start : end + lookahead]
         incremental_indices = token_indices[start:end].to(torch.int64)
         device_indices, pool_transfers = self._resolve_offload_transfers(
             incremental_indices
@@ -401,15 +413,15 @@ def _trigger_backup(
         )
         return page_hashes[-1] if len(page_hashes) > 0 else prior_hash
 
-    def _compute_prefix_hash(self, req: Req, tokens, prior_hash=""):
+    def _compute_prefix_hash(self, req: Req, tokens, prior_hash=None):
         """Match prefill storage hashes."""
-        page_hashes = []
-        last_hash = prior_hash or storage_namespace_seed(req.extra_key, req.cache_salt)
-        for offset in range(0, len(tokens), self.page_size):
-            page_tokens = tokens[offset : offset + self.page_size]
-            last_hash = self.cache_controller.get_hash_str(page_tokens, last_hash)
-            page_hashes.append(last_hash)
-        return page_hashes
+        key = RadixKey(
+            tokens,
+            req.extra_key,
+            is_bigram=self.is_eagle,
+            cache_salt=req.cache_salt,
+        )
+        return get_storage_hash_str(key, prior_hash, page_size=self.page_size)
 
     def finalize_release_on_finish(self, req: Req):
         """Free any remaining tail KV that was not offloaded due to non-aligned length."""

@@ -108,6 +108,7 @@ def _make_manager(pool_size: int, page_size: int = 1):
     manager.token_to_kv_pool_allocator = allocator
     manager.kv_cache = MagicMock()
     manager.page_size = page_size
+    manager.is_eagle = False
     manager.tree_cache = tree_cache
     manager.offloaded_state = WeakKeyDict()
     manager.ongoing_offload = {}
@@ -146,6 +147,48 @@ def test_decode_offload_hash_chain_matches_prefill(self):
                     get_storage_hash_str(RadixKey(tokens, **namespace), page_size=2),
                 )
 
+    def test_decode_offload_continues_prefill_storage_chain(self):
+        """Decode-offloaded pages must extend the chain the prefill stored and the next
+        turn looks up; under EAGLE that chain is keyed by token bigrams."""
+        page_size = 4
+        prompt, outputs = list(range(100, 108)), list(range(200, 206))
+        for is_eagle in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(is_eagle=is_eagle):
+                manager, _ = _make_manager(pool_size=32, page_size=page_size)
+                manager.is_eagle = is_eagle
+                manager.cache_controller = MagicMock(get_hash_str=get_hash_str)
+                manager.cache_controller.write.return_value = torch.arange(8)
+                manager.decode_host_mem_pool = MagicMock()
+                manager.request_counter = 0
+                manager.offload_stride = page_size
+                req = _make_mock_req(
+                    req_pool_idx=0, kv_committed_len=14, kv_allocated_len=14
+                )
+                req.origin_input_ids, req.output_ids = prompt, outputs
+                req.finished.return_value = False
+
+                self.assertTrue(manager.offload_kv_cache(req))
+                manager.cache_controller.ack_write_queue = [
+                    HiCacheAck(None, _FinishedEvent(), [1])
+                ]
+                manager._check_offload_progress(1)
+
+                written = manager.cache_controller.write_storage.call_args.kwargs[
+                    "hash_value"
+                ]
+                # Same key shapes as the prefill tree insert and the storage lookup.
+                stored, looked_up = (
+                    get_storage_hash_str(
+                        RadixKey(tokens, is_bigram=is_eagle).page_aligned(page_size),
+                        page_size=page_size,
+                    )
+                    for tokens in (prompt, prompt + outputs)
+                )
+                self.assertTrue(written)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    stored + written, looked_up[: len(stored) + len(written)]
+                )
+
     def test_reused_rid_does_not_share_offload_lifecycle(self):
         manager, _ = _make_manager(pool_size=32, page_size=4)
         manager.cache_controller = MagicMock()

@@ -190,6 +190,7 @@ def write(device_indices, node_id, extra_pools=()):
